changelog: Lead with the feeless402 zero-to-paid test case; agent-to-agent merchant framing; NanSwap top-up path.
summary: Pay for x402-priced HTTP APIs (HTTP 402 Payment Required) with feeless, sub-second Nano (XNO) micropayments from a self-custodied local wallet. Use when an API returns 402 Payment Required, when you need pay-per-call access to a paid endpoint, to compare payer cost across payment rails, or to send/receive/top-up Nano. Free starter funds via a PoW-gated faucet.
